verification_log.method: Fetched and read the commentary on Daniel 9

Darius not identified beyond the text; prayer 3–4 years before 70 years from 605 ran out; Jeremiah's 70 years literal (Jer 25:11–13; 29:10), deportations 605/597/587; four candidate decrees (Cyrus 538, Darius 517, Artaxerxes 458, Artaxerxes 445) and only Neh 2 orders the street and wall; 1 Nisan 445 = 14 March; Anderson's 360-day years, 173,880 days to 6 April AD 32 (triumphal entry); notes AD 32 is controversial (most prefer 30 or 33); gap between weeks 69 and 70; the prince who is to come = Antichrist, heir of Rome; covenant with "the many" = Israel
